_comment: DO NOT EDIT: FILE GENERATED AUTOMATICALLY BY PANEL
name: TrackMania NF / UF + XAseco
author: theanton1998@gmail.com
description: TrackMania Nations Forever / United Forever dedicated server bundled with the XAseco 1.16 controller (records, Dedimania, admin commands). Requires a MySQL/MariaDB database with the XAseco table structure imported. Runs on the plain ghcr.io/pelican-eggs/yolks:debian image (the only kind of image whose entrypoint understands Pelican/Wings' STARTUP convention); PHP itself is vendored into the persistent server directory at install time (with mysqli) since no official Pelican PHP yolk exists and no third-party PHP image (e.g. the official php:*-cli images, webdevops/php) speaks that convention.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -e
cd /mnt/server

apt-get update -qq
apt-get install -y -qq --no-install-recommends ca-certificates curl unzip xmlstarlet php-cli php-mysqli >/dev/null

DEDICATED_URL="http://files2.trackmaniaforever.com/TrackmaniaServer_2011-02-21.zip"
XASECO_URL="https://fastdl.gamemania.org/xaseco1.16-php7.zip"
TRACKLIST_URL="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Hoerli1337/pterodactyl-eggs/master/TMNF-UF/tracklist.txt"

echo "_________________________________________________________________________"
echo "Downloading TrackMania Forever dedicated server..."
curl -fsSL -o server.zip "$DEDICATED_URL"
unzip -qo server.zip -d tmserver
rm server.zip
chmod 755 tmserver/TrackmaniaServer
mkdir -p tmserver/GameData/Tracks/MatchSettings
curl -fsSL -o tmserver/GameData/Tracks/MatchSettings/tracklist.txt "$TRACKLIST_URL"

echo "_________________________________________________________________________"
echo "Server download done, downloading XAseco..."
curl -fsSL -o XAseco.zip "$XASECO_URL"
unzip -qo XAseco.zip -d xaseco
rm XAseco.zip
cd xaseco

echo "Removing files not needed in a container..."
rm -f Aseco.bat Aseco.sh AsecoF.sh
# These need to be moved for XAseco to find them
mv -f jfreu.config.php includes/jfreu.config.php 2>/dev/null || true
mv -f votes.config.php includes/votes.config.php 2>/dev/null || true

echo "_________________________________________________________________________"
echo "Writing XAseco configuration..."
# xmlstarlet escapes some angle brackets XAseco expects literal; unescape
# them with sed afterwards, same fix the original egg relied on.
xmlstarlet ed -L \
    -u "/dedimania/masterserver_account/login" -v "$MASTER_LOGIN" \
    -u "/dedimania/masterserver_account/password" -v "$MASTER_PASSWORD" \
    -u "/dedimania/masterserver_account/nation" -v "$SERVER_NATION" \
    dedimania.xml

xmlstarlet ed -L \
    -u "/settings/tmserver/login" -v "$RPC_LOGIN" \
    -u "/settings/tmserver/password" -v "$RPC_PASSWORD" \
    -u "/settings/tmserver/ip" -v "$RPC_IP" \
    -u "/settings/tmserver/port" -v "$RPC_PORT" \
    -s "/settings/aseco/masteradmins" -t elem -n "tmlogin" -v "$MASTERADMIN_LOGIN" \
    config.xml

xmlstarlet ed -L \
    -u "/settings/mysql_server" -v "$DB_HOST" \
    -u "/settings/mysql_login" -v "$DB_USER" \
    -u "/settings/mysql_password" -v "$DB_PASSWORD" \
    -u "/settings/mysql_database" -v "$DB_NAME" \
    localdatabase.xml

sed -i -e 's/}\>\>/}>>/g' -e 's/}\>/}>/g' dedimania.xml localdatabase.xml config.xml
cd /mnt/server

echo "_________________________________________________________________________"
echo "Vendoring a self-contained PHP + mysqli into the persistent server"
echo "directory. The runtime image (ghcr.io/pelican-eggs/yolks:debian) has no"
echo "PHP of its own, and packages installed in this install-stage container"
echo "don't carry over to the runtime container - only /mnt/server does."
PHP_BIN="$(readlink -f "$(command -v php)")"
EXT_DIR="$(php -r 'echo ini_get("extension_dir");')"

mkdir -p /mnt/server/phproot/bin /mnt/server/phproot/lib /mnt/server/phproot/ext
cp -L "$PHP_BIN" /mnt/server/phproot/bin/php
cp -L "$EXT_DIR/mysqli.so" /mnt/server/phproot/ext/mysqli.so

declare -A seen
queue=("$PHP_BIN" "$EXT_DIR/mysqli.so")
while [ ${#queue[@]} -gt 0 ]; do
    f="${queue[0]}"
    queue=("${queue[@]:1}")
    for lib in $(ldd "$f" 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $3}' | grep '^/'); do
        real="$(readlink -f "$lib")"
        if [ -z "${seen[$real]:-}" ]; then
            seen[$real]=1
            cp -Ln "$real" /mnt/server/phproot/lib/ 2>/dev/null || true
            queue+=("$real")
        fi
    done
done

cat > /mnt/server/phproot/run-php <<'EOS'
#!/bin/bash
DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
export LD_LIBRARY_PATH="$DIR/lib"
exec "$DIR/bin/php" -d "extension=$DIR/ext/mysqli.so" "$@"
EOS
chmod +x /mnt/server/phproot/run-php

echo "_________________________________________________________________________"
echo "Writing start.sh wrapper (runs the game server + XAseco in one container)..."
cat > /mnt/server/start.sh <<'EOS'
#!/bin/bash
cd /home/container/tmserver
./TrackmaniaServer /nodaemon /dedicated_cfg=dedicated_cfg.txt /game_settings=MatchSettings/tracklist.txt /noautoquit &
GAME_PID=$!

cleanup() {
    kill "$GAME_PID" 2>/dev/null || true
    exit 0
}
trap cleanup SIGINT SIGTERM

# give the dedicated server time to open its XML-RPC port before XAseco connects
sleep 10

cd /home/container/xaseco
/home/container/phproot/run-php controller.php &
XASECO_PID=$!

wait "$XASECO_PID"
kill "$GAME_PID" 2>/dev/null || true
EOS
chmod +x /mnt/server/start.sh

echo "_________________________________________________________________________"
echo "Installation done"
exit 0

variables.name: Master Login
variables.description: Login of the dedicated server account. Create one at https://players.trackmaniaforever.com/

variables.name: Master Password
variables.description: Password of the dedicated server account.

variables.name: Masteradmin
variables.description: Your own TrackMania NF/UF login, to get MasterAdmin rights in XAseco.

variables.name: Server Nation
variables.description: 3-letter nation code used for Dedimania, e.g. DEU, USA, GBR.

variables.name: Server Name
variables.description: Name shown in the server browser.

variables.name: Server Description
variables.description: Comment shown in the server browser.
variables.default_value: A TrackMania server, running Pelican + XAseco

variables.name: Server Password
variables.description: Leave empty for a public server.

variables.name: Max Players
variables.description: Maximum number of players (also used as spectator limit). Keep in mind ladder rules for higher values.

variables.name: Environment / Packmask
variables.description: 'stadium' or 'nations' for TMNF. For TMUF leave empty/'united', or a single environment like 'desert', or 'original'/'sunrise' for older environment sets.

variables.name: Force IP Address
variables.description: Only needed on hosts with multiple network interfaces. Leave empty otherwise.

variables.name: P2P Port
variables.description: UDP port for peer-to-peer map/skin distribution. Allocate an extra port on this server and put it here.

variables.name: RPC Port
variables.description: Local XML-RPC port XAseco uses to talk to the dedicated server. Does not need to be exposed publicly.

variables.name: RPC Login
variables.description: XML-RPC login XAseco uses internally. Leave at the default unless you know you need to change it.

variables.name: RPC / Admin Password
variables.description: Password shared by the SuperAdmin, Admin, and User authorization levels and by XAseco's connection to the dedicated server. Change this from the default before going public.

variables.name: RPC IP
variables.description: Leave at the default. XAseco connects to the dedicated server over localhost inside the same container.

variables.name: DB Host
variables.description: MySQL/MariaDB host for the XAseco database. Import the XAseco table structure before starting the server.

variables.name: DB User
variables.description: MySQL/MariaDB user with access to the XAseco database.

variables.name: DB Password
variables.description: Password for the DB user above.
